source_description_html:
Made from high quality, premium ultra-clear Tempered Glass. This tempered glass screen protector has been designed to offer the ultimate protection for your instrument cluster/dashboard.

BMW R1200GS Connectivity TFT Tempered Glass dashboard screen protector kits include:

1 x Speedo Angels Premium Tempered Glass screen protector
1 x Alcohol cleaning wipe
1 x Suede polishing cloth
1 x Dust removal strip
1 x Multi-language fitting instruction sheet
